143753.synopsis:
Rachel grew up neglected by her father and tormented by her stepmother and stepsister. On the day she finally fled from her oppressive family, she woke up to find herself lying in the middle of a snowy field.
“I’ve found you, my bride.”
The man who rescued Rachel from the snow called her his bride and brought her to his castle.
“Your eyes are filled with fear as you look at me. Do you think I’m a monster too? I know.”
“Do you hate kissing me that much?”
“Just bear with it a little longer. It’s better than having my hands touch you, isn’t it?”
The man was none other than Kaiden, the Duke of Waterford, infamous for his curse that froze everything he touched. Due to the schemes of her kidnappers, Rachel lost her voice and was mistaken by the people of the northern castle as Kaiden’s fiancée. 
Despite spending time with him, she struggled to tell him the truth—that she wasn’t his real bride—because she saw the pain he carried.
Kaiden, once thought to be the pride of his family due to his powers, had instead become a source of trouble when he lost control over them. Though rumors painted him as a cold and heartless man, the reality was far from it. 
Behind the icy facade was a tender soul who loved flowers and adorable animals. In secret, he would read romance novels, dreaming of experiencing a love as genuine as the ones in the stories.
“I want to know what true love feels like.”
Despite his longing for love, no noblewoman dared to marry him, leaving him to endure a life of loneliness. When Rachel appeared, he finally gained a bride. However, his heart grew heavy as she refused to open up to him.
“I was afraid I’d hurt you. But now, I’m even more afraid of a world without you. I don’t think I could bear it.”
A man scarred by people. A woman scarred by people.
Can the two of them reveal their true selves and share their sincere feelings with each other?

148361.synopsis:
Every novel has a male protagonist.
They are the children of destiny—wherever they go, fortune follows. Their path to success is paved with the corpses of cannon fodder, side characters, and villains.
Shen Yan transmigrated into the body of a ridiculously wealthy young master, but at the same time, he became the common cannon-fodder villain shared across many of these stories!
If he can seize the protagonist’s luck and fortuitous encounters, he will be rewarded? Then everything that belongs to the protagonist—his opportunities, his beauties, everything—will be mine!
There’s no way I’ll ever be a bootlicker. Not in this life!
With his familiarity with the plot, Shen Yan steadily takes the lead and begins his path of plunder!

160393.synopsis:
Ji Yun has transmigrated once more. This time, he is in an interstellar “All-Encompassing Love” novel featuring a Fake Young Master.
In the story, the Real Young Master (who shares his name) is rejected by his biological parents and high society because he was raised on a “tr*sh Planet.” His awakened ability is considered the most useless of all: Element Summoning. Depressed and driven to madness, he eventually becomes a stepping stone for the pampered Fake Young Master and his legion of suitors.
When his biological parents scold him for upsetting the Fake Young Master, shouting, “If you keep making trouble, go back to your tr*sh Planet!”, Ji Yun—a former top-tier host of the System Bureau who has been longing to retire—is overjoyed: “Wait, there’s such a good deal?”
Ji Yun immediately ditches the plot and runs away.
Element Summoning is mocked because it can only summon the lowest-level elemental creature, affectionately known as: The Slime.
Facing this, Ji Yun decisively pulls out his System, which currently only functions as a chat robot due to low energy: “System, are you interested in gaining a few hundred million more hosts?”
System: “…?”
In the year 20XX, the closed beta for the holographic game Desolate Planet Survival begins. It claims to be a hyper-realistic simulation with no pay-to-win mechanics and ultimate freedom.
At the start:
Netizens: “Another marketing gimmick? And in this day and age, the only starting race is a Slime? We can’t even customize our faces?”
A while later:
#IWasWrongPleaseLetMeBeASlimeForever#
#IsItReasonableForASlimeToAimForTheStars#
#DevsWhenAreYouOpeningTheTopUpStore#
One day, the Ji family finally remembers the abandoned Ji Yun. They hear he’s been running a Slime farm on a tr*sh Planet and is barely scraping by. Feeling “generous,” they decide to bring him back.
However, they are stopped at the interstellar checkpoint: “Sorry, reservations for Planet Blue are booked for the next ten years. Please come back after making an appointment.”
The Ji Family: “???” Isn’t that just a barren tr*sh Planet?
When they finally see the advertisements for Planet Blue, they fall silent.
—You call these creatures that can fight, cook, and build houses… Slimes?!
—And what the hell is that all-purpose domestic robot? Isn’t that “Destroyer No. 1,” the sentient, master-killing machine from the Federal General Bureau?!
